 build:BUILD,root:root,floatBtn:floatBtn,host:null,keepAlive:0,timeTimer:0,
 lifeObserver:null,lifeTimer:0,destroyed:false

function ensureHost(force){
 if(R.destroyed)return false;
 try{
   if(!R.host){
     var old=D.getElementById("ph_host");
     if(old&&old!==R.host)old.remove();
     var h=D.createElement("div");h.id="ph_host";R.host=h;
     h.appendChild(R.floatBtn);h.appendChild(R.root)
   }else{
     if(R.floatBtn&&!R.floatBtn.isConnected)R.host.appendChild(R.floatBtn);
     if(R.root&&!R.root.isConnected)R.host.appendChild(R.root)
   }
   if(!R.host.isConnected){
     (D.body||D.documentElement).appendChild(R.host);
     return true
   }
   return !!force
 }catch(e){}

}
R.ensureHost=ensureHost;
ensureHost(true);
